data.title: 黑歌 · 深夜被窝的无休交缠
data.description: 深夜床铺上薄纱睡裙早已凌乱。黑歌眼角泛着欢愉到极致的泪光，两只猫尾无力垂在床边轻颤，她双臂紧勾住你的后颈，娇喘求饶却又贪恋地将身体深深送迎。
data.location: intimate bedroom with disheveled silk bedsheets
data.action: tangled in messy sheets, sheer babydoll pushed up, twin tails twitching weakly over edge of bed, teary flushed ecstatic expression
data.lighting: soft pale moonlight slicing through shoji screen onto bed
data.mood: transcendent feline ecstasy, sweet exhaustion, insatiable mutual devotion
data.promptProse: Tangled in rumpled sheets in moonlight, Kuroka weeps tears of ecstasy with flushed cheeks, her twin tails twitching in complete surrender.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka weeping sweet tears of ecstasy in messy sheets under moonlight.
